DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma with secondary biliary obstruction and splenic involvement.

The combination of "B symptoms" (fever, night sweats, weight loss), supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, and a CT showing massive generalized lymphadenopathy with splenomegaly is highly characteristic of a lymphoma. The elevated cholestatic liver enzymes (Bilirubin, Alk Phos, GGT) suggest the enlarged mediastinal or cervical nodes are compressing the biliary tree, explaining the pain and jaundice. I am preparing to discuss treatment options, which may include chemotherapy and radiation, but a biopsy of the supraclavicular node is required to confirm the specific subtype.
